description:
Soften OSCAL framing from canonical to "one supported output format" in four files:

- Root `README.md` (line 145 references OSCAL Catalog/Profile/Assessment Results as part of the framework offer)
- `pkix-lint/README.md` (line 5 leads with OSCAL framing)
- `pkix-lint-cabf/README.md` (line 21 references "zlint-derived OSCAL Catalogs" as future work; may need cross-coordination with .8 decision)
- `specs/README.md` (lines 51-61 frame OSCAL as the source of truth)

No functional code changes. No new docs created. Existing factual references to the optional OSCAL emit/parse code in pkix-lint stay.

Independent of Phase 1 decisions; can ship in parallel.
title: Reframe workspace docs: root README, pkix-lint README, pkix-lint-cabf README, specs/README
